canon: The Alienmon novels (docs/SAGA_MASTER_PLAN.md) are the story canon; see docs/BOOK_SYNC_CHANGELOG.md. Quest fields added for the books are documented at the top of src/story.js.

quests.title: A Partner From the Stars

start: Dr. Vashti: Twenty years ago the Starfall brought them here. Today, one of them chooses you.
Pick your partner: Sporix, Plazmo or Gloopa.
progress: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.
complete: Dr. Vashti: A perfect match! Your Linker is synced. Take these Stasis Pods, and be kind to your partner.

quests.notes: Already implemented (starter scene). Mark complete on starter pick.

quests.title: Zib's Signal

location.spot: Steel bridge over the lava falls
DX-4 robot by the dome homes

lines: Zib zips in a happy loop around your head. Bip!
Before you leave Dustmere, you should take your new friend home to meet Mom.

objectives.hint: Take Zib home to meet Mom

lines: Mom looks up from the kitchen table... and right into one huge blinking eye.
Zib: Bip.
Mom: Well, hello to you too! And who is THIS?
Mom: A little saucer from the canyon? Any friend of yours is welcome in this house.
Mom: So it's really happening. Dr. Vashti says you're ready to head out past the bridge.
Mom: Before you go... this was your Nana Wren's. She wore it every day she ran the Recovery Bay.
It's a brass cross with a glowing blue core. Stamped on the back: R.B. No. 1.
Mom: And you're not leaving without this. Your backpack. Snacks, a map, a spare pair of socks. Don't argue.
Mom: Call home once in a while, Rook. Promise me.
Unbeknownst to Rook or his mother, someone else had already found that backpack.
Hidden deep inside, beneath the snacks and the socks, an unknown guest curled up tight... and held its breath.

start: DX-4: Bzzt! Unknown signal on the canyon bridge. Frequency... friendly?
progress: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.
complete: Time to see what lies beyond Dustmere.

quests.notes: Zib joins at the bridge (objective 2 then.gift). Objective 3: home to Mom, who gives Nana Wren's badge and the backpack; the stowaway rides along unseen.

quests.title: First Rival

start: Sola: Took the slow starter, huh? Let's see who's the better Linker.
progress: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.
complete: Sola: Not bad... for a beginner. My dad would've liked you.
Sola: He walked into the crater light six years ago. I was seven. Everyone says he got lost.
Sola: I'm going to find him. Don't fall behind!

quests.notes: Sola uses the starter strong against yours (Sporix→Plazmo, Plazmo→Gloopa, Gloopa→Sporix).

Director Thorne: Begin Phase Three.
...Back on Glyphos, Zib blinks. For a split second, its big eye reflects something enormous: a giant dark eye, slowly opening.

lines: Old Basalt: That badge... R.B. No. 1. Wren's. I knew a man who wore a jacket too big for him, and a woman who wore that badge. Good people.
Old Basalt: Here. Teo left his old mining lantern with me. It never quite goes out. Take it down the Deep Mines.
Old Basalt: And catch yourself an Ashpup. Those sooty pups love lantern light, and they can sniff out a hidden ledge.

objectives.hint: Find Teo's cache in the Deep Mines

location.spot: Teo's cache on a hidden ledge

lines: Behind a hidden ledge, Teo's lantern flares. There's a little crystal recorder wedged in the rock.
Teo (recording): If you find this, Sola, I'm not lost. I'm following them home.
Tucked under the recorder is a page torn from Teo's journal. He copied one line from Imogen Vashti's Codex pages, and the stone it came from was damaged:
"She is scattered so she may live..." The rest of the line is gone.
Teo (note): Imogen never told us how it ends. I think it's the most important line in the whole Codex.
You'd better keep the recording safe for Sola.

objectives.intro: You came all this way to stop me? I'm SO close to finding my dad!
objectives.lose: ...Fine. You win. But Helix is going to find him. They promised.

objectives.title: The Observation Deck
lines: After the battle you play Sola the recording from the Deep Mines. "If you find this, Sola, I'm not lost."
Before she can answer, the deck's big screen flickers on by itself. Two files play.
Director Thorne (log): Reyes was an acceptable loss. The data he left behind was worth it.
Sola goes completely still.
The second file: a reactor alarm, a woman's voice, then silence. Elena Thorne, lost in a Helix accident.
Director Thorne (log): If the Rift can power anything, it can power a way back to her.
Director Thorne (log): Project Unity is nearly complete. One of every species. Carry them all through the Rift and the Seedmother regrows life the way I choose.
Director Thorne (log): She will give me Elena back.

start: Admin Bronn: Thorne's lost his mind. That Rift will swallow us all. Beat me and I'll open the way to Vex.
progress: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.
complete: Sola: ...An acceptable loss. That's what he called my dad.

quests.notes: Vex is a boss, not a Relay Keeper: no Signal Shard. Bronn leaks Thorne's plan.

objectives.title: Sola turns
lines: Sola rips the Helix patch off her sleeve and throws it on the floor.
Sola: He's not data. He's my dad.
Sola: I'm with you. Let's finish this, together.

objectives.intro: Two brats for the price of one? The Director will be thrilled.
objectives.lose: Ugh! Fine. The Director already has what he needs.

start: Sola: They lied to me. Thorne never wanted to find my dad. He wants to OPEN the thing that took him.
progress: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.
complete: Admin Vex escapes in a pod, shrieking about the Director.
Sola: We did it. Together.

lines: On the way out, the freed captives flood past you. One stays behind: a tiny crystal hatchling that glows like Teo's lantern.
It's a Lumivex hatchling. It looks at Sola for a long moment, then climbs into her jacket pocket.
Sola: ...Hi. Hi, little one. Okay. You can come with me.
On the shuttle home, Sola falls asleep against your shoulder, the hatchling glowing softly in her pocket.

objectives.title: The Prophecy Shrine
objectives.hint: Follow Liss to the third wind shrine in the Floating Gardens
lines: At the third wind shrine, the wind falls silent. Carved across the whole shrine wall is one great picture.
Liss: You have been told she stayed behind on Ystra. She didn't. She couldn't.
Liss: As the hungry one ate our sky, the Seedmother broke her whole self apart into the seedpods. Every Alienmon carries a piece of her. Zib. Your partner. All of them.
Liss: On Ystra only the Heartroot is left, one last root in the crater where her tree stood. And it is fading.
Liss: This is the rest of the line Teo copied: "She is scattered so she may live. Whoever reunites all her children will let the Seedmother grow again, and her world with her."
Liss: Reunite, Linker. Not cage. Every one of them stays itself.

start: Echo & Iris: We already saw you climb these stairs. We also saw the sky tear open.
progress: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.
complete: Echo & Iris: The vision is clear now. The Rift opens at the Starfall crater. Take the seventh Shard.

lines: At the last wind shrine, the Ystran echo Liss is clearer than ever.
Liss: I launched the last seedpod. The one carrying Zib. The fold was closing, and someone had to push it through.
Liss: I stayed behind on purpose. Someone had to sing it on its way.
Zib's lights flicker through every color, then go soft and blue. It's crying in lights.

objectives.hint: Read Kade's schematics in his ruined lab

lines: Mortimer Kade: I built Thorne's Rift engine. Look at the key slot. It's tuned to one frequency.
Mortimer Kade: The eighth tower's resonance. The moment you win Shard 8, Thorne gets his key.
Mortimer Kade: But if you don't, the cracked seal fails on its own. There is no safe answer.

objectives.hint: Win Shard 8, knowing it helps Thorne?
options: There's no other way. Go on.

lines: Sola: Then we do it together. And we stop him at the other end.
Mortimer Kade: ...All right. Gravewell Tower. I'll be waiting.

start: Mortimer Kade: I built the Rift engine for Thorne. I scratched the logo off my coat the day I understood what it would wake.
progress: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.
complete: Mortimer Kade: Eight Shards. The towers will sing. Go to the crater before Thorne does.

lines: All eight Shards ring at once. Zib rises into the air, and its big eye projects a soft, shimmering light.
A woman's voice fills the room, warm and huge, and you know it before she says a word.
Seedmother: If you hear this, my scout found a true listener.
Seedmother: I am not gone. I am in every one of you, scattered so I may live.
Seedmother: Heal the one who hungers, my sibling who took in too much. Then bring my children home together, and I will grow again.

quests.title: Harbor Reclaimed

lines: Captain Marsh: A Helix freighter just tied up at the end of my east pier for repairs. Guess what's in its hold?

objectives.intro: Helix Directive! This freighter is restricted!

objectives.hint: Take back Thalassa's tower core

objectives.title: The Harbor Tower
lines: Captain Marsh slots the core back into the Harbor Tower. For a second, nothing.
Then the whole tower hums, and a beam of light shoots up into the night. Every boat in the harbor sounds its horn.
Captain Marsh: Now we're even.

start: Captain Marsh: Linker! Get to Port Saltreach. I've found where Helix is hiding my tower core.
progress: Captain Marsh: The freighter won't wait forever. Move!
complete: Captain Marsh: The seal's got one more tower singing. Go get that crater, kid.

objectives.intro: Helix Directive! Stand aside, this tower is ours now!

lines: Hank Briggs: That's my kid. Battling beside me, not behind me.

objectives.intro: Helix Directive! Shut that broadcast down!
objectives.lose: They're... they're still on the air!

objectives.title: Static goes live
lines: DJ Static: This is Static, live on every frequency in the Kessler system. You need to hear this.
Director Thorne (log): Reyes was an acceptable loss.
DJ Static: And this: Project Unity. Helix has been caging one of every Alienmon to force the Seedmother's power. Look at these cages, people.
On every world, people stop and listen. By morning, nobody believes Helix anymore.
DJ Static: The Keepers are with you, Linker. When you need us, just call. We'll sing.

start: Hank Briggs: Helix crews are hitting the towers, trying to crack them before you reach the crater.
Kit: I rigged a Shard relay out of Nana Wren's old ship radio. Now your Shards can talk to every tower, and Static can call every Keeper!
Hank Briggs: Ferrox first. Then Static's tower on Neonis. Kit, you're with the Linker.
progress: Hank Briggs: The towers won't hold themselves!
complete: Hank Briggs: Every Keeper's on the line now. Whatever happens at that crater, you won't be alone.

quests.notes: Book 3 Ch 3-6: the Keepers hold the towers; Static broadcasts Thorne's logs. Completing it adds the Keepers singing to the sealing.

Strand: Field Division. Second Class. ...Resigning.
Strand: Ostrander's soldiers have the crater sealed tight. But nobody stops a Helix shuttle. Get in. I'll fly you past the cordon.

objectives.intro: Do you know what infinite energy means? It means no accident is ever final.
objectives.lose: ...Elena isn't in there. There's nothing in there but hunger.

objectives.title: The Rift closes: the Signal song
lines: Thorne stares through the Rift, looking for the power he was promised. He sees Ystra: grey, barren, empty. No Seedmother to command. Nothing to answer him.
Only Oblivane, starving and enormous. The power he wanted doesn't exist. He drops to his knees.
Director Thorne: Reroute the engine to the seal. I'll hold it. Go!
Zib pours its light into the Shards. One by one, its lights start to go out.
You, Sola, Novaryx and Zib start to sing the Signal. It's the Spore Choir's song from Sporeholm. Hmm-mm-mmm.

keepers_call: Over Static's broadcast, every Keeper joins in: Hank, Dr. Moor, Captain Marsh, Static, Basalt, Ingrid, Echo and Iris, Kade.
On every world, every Alienmon sings with them.

lines: Every Alienmon's song folds into one voice: a woman's, warm and huge. For a heartbeat the Seedmother is whole.
{starter3} blazes like a small star and pushes the Rift closed with light.

start: Director Thorne: The Rift is power, child. Power the universe wasted on refugees.
progress: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.
complete: The Shards blaze and the Rift folds shut. From the last of its light steps Teo Reyes, an adult Lumivex at his side. Sola runs to him.
Teo: Sola? ...You're so tall.
Teo: The seal can only be healed from Ystra's side. And there's something you need to know.
Teo: The Heartroot, the last piece of her on Ystra, is dying. If it dies, the legend can't come true.

quests.notes: Sets flag 'rift', which unlocks Apex Array.

quests.title: Homecoming

objectives.hint: Join the Starfall Festival bonfire in Dustmere's plaza

lines: Dustmere is celebrating twenty years since the Starfall. The bridge glows all on its own.
Dusty: Twenty years ago, four kids climbed down into that crater and found the Mother Pod. I always told it like a fairy tale. Tonight I'll tell it true.
Dusty: Imogen Vashti. Kael Thorne. Orra Venn. And Teo Reyes.
Everybody around the fire turns and looks at Teo. He just smiles and pokes the coals.

objectives.hint: Climb to the Recovery Bay attic (the ladder behind the cabinet)

lines: Up in the Recovery Bay attic, under a dusty blanket, you find Nana Wren's journal.
Nana Wren (journal): The night the stars fell, three pods of baby saucers came to my door. Little things with one big eye, like scouts.
Nana Wren (journal): I nursed them all night. And I heard a voice singing, far away and so tired. So I sang back.
Nana Wren (journal): Every pod sang a different note of the same song. I think they're all pieces of one mother. So I sang the missing notes back.
Zib chose you because the same Signal runs in your family.

objectives.hint: Read the journal's last page to DX-4

lines: Nana Wren (journal, last page): I built a little robot to listen for the scout's frequency, and to watch over my grandchild when I can't.
Nana Wren (journal): I taught him my favorite word. Probably.
DX-4 is quiet for a long, long time.
DX-4: I KNEW THAT. PROBABLY.

objectives.title: The trial on Neonis
objectives.hint: Go to the courtroom on Neon Boulevard
lines: In the Linker League courtroom, Strand testifies with shaking hands.
Dr. Vashti testifies too, and confesses her own twenty years of silence, in public, for everyone to hear.
Director Thorne pleads guilty to everything. He looks at no one.
A week later, a letter arrives from his cell. Folded inside is a Codex page he copied twenty years ago.
Codex page: The door that is a road opens only for a scout and a listener, together.
Codex page: But she cannot grow while the hungry one still hungers. Heal it first. Then call her children home.

objectives.hint: Catch Admin Vex aboard the smuggler's freighter (Saltreach Market pier)
objectives.intro: You again?! I'm not going back to that Director. I'm not going ANYWHERE!

lines: Captain Marsh clamps the cuffs on Admin Vex. Marsh: That's for my tower. And my harbor. And my logbook.
Pell steps up onto the deck, chest out. Pell: Helix Directive! Field Division! ...
Pell: ...Former.
Captain Marsh: Not bad, kid. There's room on my crew for a man who knows when to quit.

objectives.title: An invitation
lines: A message arrives from Apex Array, from Orra Venn, the Prime Linker and the last of the Crater Four.
Orra Venn (message): Come to the Summit.
Dr. Vashti reads it twice. Vashti: Orra and I haven't spoken in fifteen years.

start: Mom: You're home! Come on, the whole town is at the Starfall Festival tonight.
progress: Mom: Go on, enjoy the festival. You've earned it.
complete: Mom: The Summit, huh? Go on. Make your Nana proud.

quests.notes: Book 4 Part One and Two: the festival, the journal, DX-4, the trial, Vex captured off Thalassa (moved here from the postgame), the invitation.

lines: Before you leave for the Summit, Hank hands Kit a Gearhound and his old welding goggles.
Hank Briggs: You fix everything for everybody, kid. Let somebody look after you for once.
Kit puts the goggles on. They're much too big. Kit doesn't take them off for a week.

objectives.intro: My first Linker still works. Let's see if yours can carry what mine carried.

lines: Orra Venn: I kept the Codex locked up for nineteen years and called it protecting people.
Orra Venn: You carried the truth across fourteen worlds, in the open. That's the difference.
Orra Venn: Tonight Imogen and I will tell every world the whole prophecy, in the open. They should know what the Reunion is.

shielded_zib: Orra Venn: And when it mattered, you put yourself between your friend and the light. That was the test.
Orra Venn: The Unifier has to choose a partner over winning. Otherwise they'd only collect. Not unite.

objectives.hint: Meet Dr. Vashti at the Great Telescope

location.spot: Dr. Vashti at the Great Telescope

lines: Dr. Vashti: Thorne's Codex page. "A door that is a road, opened only by a scout and a listener together."
Dr. Vashti: The Great Telescope can focus all eight Shards into a Vortex, if the lens is right. So Kit and I built one from Teo's crystal map.
Dr. Vashti: The Shards are set. Nothing's happening. ...A scout and a listener. Of course. You and Zib, together.
Dr. Vashti: And every Keeper has promised: when the call comes, they'll bring their Alienmon through.

objectives.title: The Vortex
lines: You and Zib hum the Spore Choir's song. Hmm-mm-mmm.
The sky above the telescope folds open into a spinning road of light.
Dr. Vashti: Go. I'll hold the road open from this side. However long it takes.
A last message from Thorne arrives on her screen: "Bring her home, all of her."

start: Zib's lights blink in a rhythm you've never seen. It's pointing up, at the Great Telescope.
progress: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.
complete: You step out of the Vortex under a huge, tired red sun. Ystra is barren: grey crystal, nothing growing. The crystal forest from your dream is a dead, chiming ruin.
Liss: Look. Far off, at the bottom of that empty crater. That single faint glow is the Heartroot, the last piece of her on Ystra.
Liss: The legend says whoever reunites all her children lets her grow again. But nothing can grow while Oblivane still hungers.

objectives.hint: Reach the Heartroot in the empty crater

lines: At the bottom of the empty crater, the Heartroot glows very faintly. It's almost dark.
You understand all at once: one team isn't enough. The legend needs every Alienmon. All of her children, together.

objectives.title: The Reunion: Choir
lines: Kit's Shard relay and Static's frequency send the call home to Kessler.
Above the crater, the Warp Gate wakes for the first time and opens a road between the worlds.
And they come through it: Hank, Captain Marsh, DJ Static, Ingrid, Old Basalt, Echo and Iris, Kade, every trainer you ever battled, even Pell.
Wild Alienmon of every kind pour through the Gate behind them.
Every Alienmon sings one note of her song. Nobody gives up their body or their life, only a note. Every one of them stays itself.
The Heartroot drinks the song. Green floods out across Ystra.
A world-tree of crystal and leaves rises out of the crater: the Seedmother, growing again.
She holds Oblivane, small and silver now, like a moon in her branches.

options: Keep Kessler as a shared home
Both: one home across two worlds

location.note: tile map or future painted map; place this spot when building

objectives.hint: Seedmother: My children, where would you like to live?

1: Seedmother: Then my children will make Ystra green again, and the Warp Gate will carry them to their friends whenever they wish.
2: Seedmother: Then my children will stay with the friends who took them in, and the Warp Gate will bring them home to visit.
3: Seedmother: Both. Of course. Why should a home have only one door?

start: Liss: Now. The Heartroot's crater. Before its light goes out.
progress: Keep at it, Linker. You've got this.
complete: Seedmother: Thank you, my children. Every one of you still yourselves.
Seedmother: Take this seed. The Gate will stay open, a road between your two homes.

quests.notes: The choice changes ending dialogue only. Both paths unlock the Warp Gate teaser.

lines: Seedmother: Little scout. Your mission is done. You can stay home now, with me.
Zib looks up at the Seedmother. Then it looks at you, for a long time.
Zib: ...Biiip.
Seedmother: A scout's job is to find a home. You found one.
Zib zips back to your shoulder, every light glowing gold.

lines: One year later.
The Warp Gate hums over Dustmere. Through it, green against Ystra's new sky, you can see the Seedmother's tree.
Tamsin is still exploring Ystra. Teo and Dr. Vashti run a research station between the worlds.
Admin Vex is still in prison, and Captain Marsh still visits just to gloat.
A letter arrives from Kael Thorne: "I wanted to own her. You set her free. Elena would have liked you. Tell your Zib thank you."
At the Observatory, a nervous new thirteen-year-old is choosing a first partner.
Over on the table, one shy capsule sits all alone. Nobody picked it. You walk over to it.
THE END of the Alienmon Chronicles. (Every Alienmon is a piece of her. Open the Xenodex and press A to see the Heartroot.)

objectives.title: The ghost ship
lines: You climb down into the ghost ship's hold. Rows of empty cages rattle in the swell.
The howl comes from the very last cage. It isn't a ghost at all. It's a lost little Chirpod, calling and calling for anyone to answer.
You open the cage. The Chirpod hops onto your arm and won't let go.
objectives.hint: Board the ghost ship at the tip of the west pier
The lost Chirpod looks up at you.

lines: The Chirpod chirps happily and tucks itself under your collar.
